summary.en-US: Minimal speed dial for your bookmarks! Completely free and open source: no ads, no account, no tracking, no BS.

version.approval_notes: TypeScript bundled with esbuild, not minified. Rebuild: npm ci && npm run build, needs Node 26. Output is in dist/firefox. Optional Sync: identity.launchWebAuthFlow with Google (scope drive.appdata), data goes only to the user's own Drive app folder; asked for with the optional data collection permissions bookmarksInfo and websiteContent.
